info.title: API.SH: BAUHAUS
info.description: The BAUHAUS API from API.SH: public BAUHAUS data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The products of a BAUHAUS category with the same fields, filters and sorts as search, plus its name, breadcrumbs and subcategories. A top-level category answers with its subcategories. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bauhaus-category

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Category id or a bauhaus.info/<name>/c/<id> link.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand names, comma separated.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: `id:value` pairs from `filters[]`, separated by `;`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `relevance` (default), `price-asc`, `price-desc` or `topseller`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (36 products per page).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
BAUHAUS products for search words: product id, brand, name, key attributes, link, image, price and unit, rating and review count, labels, with the total and every filter the shop offers for the result (category, brand, product type, availability, offers, seller, rating and technical attributes) with option counts. Narrow with `brand` and `filters`, sort by price or best sellers. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bauhaus-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand names from the `brand` filter, comma separated.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Other filters as `id:value` pairs from `filters[].id` and `filters[].options[].value`, separated by `;` (several values of one filter: comma separated), e.g. `type:Akku-Bohrschrauber;seller:BAUHAUS`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `relevance` (default), `price-asc`, `price-desc` or `topseller`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (36 products per page).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: BAUHAUS product at one store: shelf, pickup time, stock
get.description:
One product at one BAUHAUS store: the shelf and field where it stands (the store's own location codes) with a link to the store's floor map, the stock status and available quantity, the expected pickup time for a reservation, whether it can be reserved in store or ordered online and how many, and (with a postcode) the home delivery estimate and order-by time.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bauhaus-store-availability

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A product id (e.g. 20724487) or a bauhaus.info product link.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: The store's id from /bauhaus/v1/stores.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: A German postcode for the home delivery estimate.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Store stock of one BAUHAUS product in every store within a radius of a store (or of the store nearest to a postcode or city): per store the stock status (in_stock, low_stock, out_of_stock), the available quantity, the distance in km and the time the stock was read; store name and address are filled in for the stores near the given postcode or city. Unknown products, or products not sold in stores, answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bauhaus-store-stock

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A product id (e.g. 20724487) or a bauhaus.info product link.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: Centre the search on this store (id from /bauhaus/v1/stores). One of store_id, postcode or city is required.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: A German postcode: centre on the nearest store.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: A German city: centre on the store nearest to it.

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Search radius in km, 1-300 (default 100).

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: true: only stores with at least one unit available.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
BAUHAUS stores (Fachcentren) nearest to a German postcode or city: store id, name, operating company, slug, street address, postcode, city, coordinates, distance in km and opening hours for each weekday.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bauhaus-stores

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: A German postcode (5 digits). One of postcode or city is required.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: A German city or town name (its first postcode is used), e.g. Berlin.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
